mount: apps/web/src/components/shell/org-mark.ts
// Cutting a name at a grapheme boundary is the job of shortOrgName in packages/shared.
const segmenter = new Intl.Segmenter(undefined, { granularity: 'grapheme' });

export function cutName(name: string, limit: number): string {
  return Array.from(segmenter.segment(name), (part) => part.segment)
    .slice(0, limit)
    .join('');
}
